newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Central Bank sells 534 bln rbls bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia Central Bank sells 534 bln rbls bills, bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank sold 534.00 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Thursday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:

The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 23006 issue closed on Thursday at 77.31 percent, the 23005 issue closed at 78.07 percent, the 24011 issue closed at 100.44 percent and the 24012 issue closed at 98.20.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the Central Bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
